def power_mod(base, exp):
    res = 1
    MOD = 1000000007
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % MOD
        base = (base * base) % MOD
        exp >>= 1
    return res

class UnionFind:
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.parent = list(range(n))
        self.size = [1] * n
        self.count = n

    def find(self, u):
        if self.parent[u] != u:
            self.parent[u] = self.find(self.parent[u])
        return self.parent[u]

    def unite(self, u, v):
        u = self.find(u)
        v = self.find(v)
        if u != v:
            if self.size[u] < self.size[v]:
                u, v = v, u
            self.parent[v] = u
            self.size[u] += self.size[v]
            self.count -= 1

def main():
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    visited = [False] * p
    uf = UnionFind(p)
    for i in range(p):
        j = i
        while not visited[j]:
            visited[j] = True
            uf.unite(i, j)
            j = (j * k) % p
    c = uf.count
    if k != 1:
        c -= 1
    print(power_mod(p, c))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
